verdict.rationale: Workable's API supports scoped permissions via named scopes (e.g. r_jobs, w_candidates, r_account) and permission_sets that can be attached to tokens, which allows creating least-privilege API tokens for integrations/agents. However, there's no explicit documentation of per-agent credential issuance, short-lived/expiring tokens, or a dedicated flow for provisioning scoped credentials specifically to AI agents (the MCP server docs describe capability access but not credential scoping specifics). missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-specific credential issuance workflow, token expiry/rotation controls, and independent confirmation that scopes can be combined into truly minimal custom grants for agent use.
